findings: the prior plan named Draft, Proposal, Approval and Lease but did not define their independent revisions and transitions
the generic broad-role approval and caller-optional expiry were not sufficient as an ecommerce approval policy
draftOnly was documented by the risk classifier but not identified as an unenforced runtime condition
the Lease contract lacked the W5-02 joint binding and budget reservation lifecycle
editable ActionDraftRevision, immutable submit-to-Proposal, exact ApprovalSet and single-use ExecutionLease are now separate authorities
server ApprovalPolicyRevision owns eligibility slots, order, independence and maximum validity
draftOnly, allowlist, R4 and unknown conditions are explicit submit, decide and acquire fail-closed gates
Lease atomically binds actionBindingHash and budget or quota reservation with auditable expiry and revocation release
the UI projects command readiness and disabled reasons instead of inferring authority from roles
W5-03 remains unchecked until W5-02 and all named implementation dependencies are GREEN
